description: ADR 0031: (1) <engine>-infer / -chat greedy decode with step_greedy (device argmax): generated IDs and chat snapshot files bitwise equal to the previous build; (2) speculative decoding with the verify pass, the MTP absorb of all verify rows and the draft chain linked on the device (EmbedBf16Picked), against one sync per head forward (--no-fused-draft). Device draft, 8192-row draft vocabulary, same 8 prompts and settings as metal-m5-device-argmax.json, plain baseline with the device argmax. Two runs each.

commands.speculative: qwen-rust-inference metal-speculative --library target/metal/libqwen_metal.dylib --model-dir models/qwen --prompt-file spec/measurements/mtp-prompts.txt --max-new-tokens 128 --depth K --draft-vocab 8192 --draft-vocab-text target/mtp-vocab-text.txt --plain-device-argmax [--no-fused-draft]
commands.infer: qwen-rust-inference metal-infer --library target/metal/libqwen_metal.dylib --model-dir models/qwen --prompt P --max-new-tokens 128 (first 4 prompts of mtp-prompts.txt, previous and new build, twice)

metal_chat_snapshots: metal-chat --prompt 'Rustの所有権を短く説明して' --max-new-tokens 48 --save-state A, then --load-state A --prompt '例を1つ' --max-new-tokens 32 --save-state A.2: both files byte-identical between the previous and the new build
machine: Apple M5, 16 GB, macOS 27.3, BF16 weights, default kernels (tensor)
